status: candidate-tuning — round22 §6 initial inputs mapped to joint-local constraints; reviewed table, pending stress-pose fixture evidence

frames.convention: joint-local rest frame: +Y aims from the joint toward its listed child (bone axis); +X = normalize(+Y × +Zworld); +Z completes the right-handed basis. Down-pointing bones therefore share bend axis −X: elbow flexion reads positive, knee flexion negative, exactly as the limits table declares.

channelModel.swing: two dof — pitch about local +X, roll about local +Z
channelModel.twist: one dof — axial rotation about local +Y (the bone axis)
channelModel.hinge: one dof — bend about local +X, sign per joint range
channelModel.compose: q = qx(pitch) · qz(roll) · qy(twist), intrinsic order X-Z-Y, degrees in channel data
channelModel.interpolate: per-channel linear in degrees across a transition window; quaternions compose only after channel evaluation

mirror.limits: mirrored channels negate and swap the declared range: [lo,hi] → [−hi,−lo]
mirror.note: L side is authored in this file; R side is derived. Mirrored-side fixtures are required evidence (round22 §10).

pelvis.note: root motion lives here and nowhere else — limb joints never translate

head.note: upper-neck pivot — neck-base motion stays on 'neck'; do not merge them

pole.note: elbow tip points behind the character at rest — preset-local frame, not a world constant

forearmTwist.L.note: pronation/supination owns the forearm's axial channel — the elbow stays a pure hinge and the wrist has no duplicated roll

pole.note: knee tip points forward at rest

ankle.L.note: ankle motion is separate from foot roll — heel/ball/toe pivots live on foot.L

foot.L.note: the tested foot-roll control: heel/ball/toe pivots land on the skeleton landmarks of the same name

combined.note: individually legal neck+head channels must not sum to an implausible gaze — checked on evaluated pose, not on inputs

forbidden.appliesTo: every joint except pelvis (root position) — a limb that translates or scales is detached, not posed
